entry_points.text: Boot enters via top init single-CPU, grace creation and scheduler transition; runtime enters via power notifier and polled expedited start tolerating pre-init callers.

Expedited entries cover completion work, need-QS marking with reschedule, IPI handlers with immediate versus deferred report by nesting and enablement, polled drain with bounded logging and blocking wait helper.
Nocb entries cover bypass trylock and flush, persistent group and callback threads, deferred timer, current-CPU flush, lazy reclaim callbacks, boot grouping init and context-switch hook.

exports.text: CPU hotplug surface covers online, starting, dead report, callback migration, dead accounting, dying trace and offline handling.
Boot and coordination surface covers top init, scheduler transition, async hurry and relax, oddness announce and polled expedited start plus conditional helpers.

hazards.text: Bringup warns on multiple online CPUs, missing workqueues and bad geometry; thread allocation warns once; migration warns on inconsistencies and leftover callbacks.

Long periods risk missed QS, wrap, overload and stalls, mitigated by force timing, overload masks, wrap flags and diagnostic snapshots; expedited races use mask rechecks, exclusive ownership and release ordering with separate sequences.

Concurrent deoffload plus reoffload can skip members unless a fresh scan follows additions; callback parking warns on sleeping-with-work and empty wakeups; reclaim must not block and revalidates length and offload under locks.

invariants.text: Nocb per-CPU startup waits for full scheduler and setup, ensures group then callback thread with wake-or-park by offload, deoffloads on failure; one build is empty. Deferred QS and per-node nocb init each have active versus empty variants.

Online joins leaf force mask and manages tick dependency; starting joins init masks once and forces late QS if blocking; dead path drains deferred work, reports QS then clears started; migration merges lists with barrier entrainment and validation; offline, dead and dying update masks, counts and traces.
Power prepare hurries async work and expedited grace, post suspend relaxes both, other actions ignored with success always. Hurry and relax adjust a global nesting counter only with lazy support.

Boot creates grace thread with timestamp reset before publication, verifies single CPU and no switches, fixes node sequences, builds geometry with locks, masks, ranges, parents and expedited state, then binds CPUs to leaves.

Normal and expedited masks stage next to initial to active with offline capture; hierarchy covers contiguous CPU ranges with parent links and upward bits; blocked readers queue with normal, expedited and boost selectors; sequences increase monotonically with needed markers and wrap flags.

Nocb grouping auto-sizes stride and links mask members to leaders; group wait keeps smallest pending normal and expedited sequences with bypass and lazy classification; sequences reset after cycles; offload marker and list linkage toggle together; lazy reclaim sums lengths with empty and stop signals.

locks.text: Online uses leaf lock with IRQ save for force mask; starting orders offline then barrier then leaf; dead holds offline plus leaf with IRQs off; migration starts under barrier then destination locks, dropping barrier early.

Nocb spawn serializes group startup and failure deoffload with group and global mutexes; grace publication holds root lock with IRQs off; polled expedited start takes poll lock with IRQ save only after init.

Root lock guards sequence and grace control; barrier mutex plus snapshot spin guard, separate expedited entry and wakeup mutexes, offline spin guard and per-node thread mutex; nodes add forcing, expedited and poll guards; bypass uses IRQ-disabled trylock; leaf guards IRQ-work pending.

Per-CPU nocb lock guards toggle, scan, flush and sleep flags; group lock guards toggle pointer and sleep; node lock advances callbacks with IRQs already off, nonblocking on callback path; reclaim uses trylock only; callback execution disables BH with brief extended QS.

state_machines.text: Thread conditions order stopped, running, waiting, off-CPU, yielding; grace sleep moves idle, wait and start done, hotplug, init, wait and forcing done, cleanup started and done with orthogonal init, force and overload command flags.
Boot moves inactive to init to fully active enabling thread creation; nocb ensures group before callback thread, wakes when offloaded else parks, returning to non-offloaded on failure.

Group thread scans members, wakes callbacks and grace thread, records needs, then polls, sleeps for work or waits on node queue, handling one pending toggle; callback thread waits on sleep flag, honors park only when sleeping, runs one batch then rechecks.

Blocked insertion picks head, tail or after normal or expedited markers from combined occupancy and blocking bits, updating first markers; switch path traces, queues still-nested readers or handles deferred QS, then notes normal, expedited and task QS.

structs.text: Combining node tracks sequence views, three-generation normal and expedited masks with offline and overload masks, topology bounds and parent, blocked lists with selectors, boost state, forcing, expedited and poll guards with queues, nocb grace queues and thread mutex.

Per-CPU state tracks sequences, deficit flags, leaf link, segmented list with limits, watching and barrier snapshots, overload and IRQ work, plus offload grouping, locks, wait queues and sleep flags, bypass and regular lists and progress sequences.

Global controller holds node array, CPU counts, sequence and grace thread control, barrier and expedited coordination, timing and identity, offline guard and sync queues; plus deficit carrier, stall snapshot, waiter pool element, expedited work carrier and blocked-task linkage with paired sequences.
Encodings use small integers for thread conditions, grace command bits, nocb wake levels and blocked-task presence markers.

Timing scales forcing interval with HZ with divisor for large systems, stall ratelimit delay, ten-second lazy flush with mutable threshold, per-tick bypass allowance, and bounded synchronize waiter pool sizes.
